value.rationale: A complete second-commutant classification for every idempotent in a canonical family of noncommutative finite monoids, independent of block shape; centralizers may vary drastically but have uniform two/three-element center. The exact invariant reconstructs each nontrivial idempotent as the centralizer's sole nontrivial central member, motivating double-centralizer study beyond prior first-centralizer enumerations.
